families.label: Confirmed
families.meaning: Only scope-specific decisions, observed construction or post-baseline operation.

families.label: Dated plans
families.meaning: Confirmed capacity and current dated commissioning plans.

families.label: All announced
families.meaning: All active announced capacity, with delivery timing retained.

measures.mw: Cumulative commissioned capacity added after the fixed baseline year-end.
measures.annual_addition_mw: Capacity added during the calendar year; interval across early/late paths, not the difference between independent interval bounds.
measures.future_addition_mw: Additional deployment after the end of the assessment calendar year; not a reconstruction of delivery within that year.
measures.remaining_mw: Announced incremental capacity not yet delivered at year-end; includes evidence classes excluded by the family weights.
